newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends with small losses, trade lackluster.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends with small losses, trade lackluster.

text.p: Weekly export and supply and demand data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture failed to inspire much interest in rice futures Thursday, traders said.
"The reports didn't offer us anything much and today was really, really light," said one pit trader.
USDA reported weekly net rice export sales of 32,000 tonnes, up 44 percent from the week-ago figure but 20 percent below the four-week average.
Pit traders said volume in rice should remain quiet through the summer as the U.S. crop matures.
Some commercial selling was seen in the new crop contracts, floor traders said.
Rice closed one to two cents per cwt lower, with July down one at $11.47 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 100 contracts, below the 176 traded Wednesday.
